title: Official Notification Age Rule & Relaxation Contract

architecture.hardcodedLogicEliminated: switch(category) { case SC: +5; case OBC: +3; } completely deleted.
architecture.governanceModel: All age relaxation must be declared in official EligibilityRule objects of ruleType AGE_RELAXATION.

evaluationLifecycle: Step 1: Calculate student age in years at reference date (nowIso or notification cutoff date).
Step 2: Check student age against baseMax in AGE_MAX rule.
Step 3: If age <= baseMax, rule passes with base eligibility reason.
Step 4: If age > baseMax, search verified rules for an AGE_RELAXATION rule targeting candidate category.
Step 5: If verified relaxation rule found, apply relaxationYears to baseMax. If age <= effectiveMax, pass with relaxation audit reason.
Step 6: If NO verified relaxation rule exists for candidate category, rule FAILS. Zero assumed relaxation.

adversarialProof.scWithoutRuleTest: PASSED (Evaluated age 33 vs baseMax 30 => FAILED with reason "No official age relaxation rule provided")
adversarialProof.obcWithoutRuleTest: PASSED (Evaluated age 32 vs baseMax 30 => FAILED with reason "No official age relaxation rule provided")
adversarialProof.scWithOfficialRuleTest: PASSED (Evaluated age 33 vs baseMax 30 + 5y official rule => PASSED)
